description: This file is a unit test for the CategoryRepository class in the wallet_frontend project. It defines a mock repository implementation (_MemoryCategoryRepo) to simulate database operations in memory and contains tests verifying CRUD functionalities and duplicate name handling.

classes.name: _MemoryCategoryRepo
classes.description: A mock in-memory implementation of CategoryRepository used for testing purposes, simulating database interactions.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new Category to the in-memory list, assigning a new ID. Throws ArgumentError if a category with the same name (case-insensitive) exists.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing Category identified by its ID. Returns 1 if successful, 0 if the category was not found.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a Category by its ID. Always returns 1.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list of all categories currently stored in memory.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a Category by its ID, or returns null if not found.
